rule: Each arrow starts at the box edge where the dashed line (or implied edge) is and points away from that edge, moving across the box (right from left edge, down from top edge, up from bottom edge). In four figures the arrow heads away from its start side.
options_check: 1: dashed line at left edge, arrow points right away from it, fits. 2: arrow starts at top edge, points down, fits. 3: dashed line near bottom, arrow points up away from it, fits. 4: dashed line near top but arrow points up toward and through the top edge, so it breaks the rule. 5: arrow starts at bottom edge, points up, fits.
redraw_diffs: Minor only: line weights and shadow offsets differ, and the dashed line in 1 looks slightly slanted in the original. Arrow directions, dash positions and arrow overshoot beyond the box (4 top, 5 bottom, 3 bottom) match, so the answer is not affected.
